title: 第二十八章 夏天第二十九章 活该找不到女朋友
lines: 第二十八章夏天
赵天河的瞳孔猛然收缩，这个人力量何其恐怖。
如果是一般人，就算又足够大的力量，也只能把柳树打断，像这样直接打穿，还需要精准的力量掌控。
这个人绝对是武者！而且实力不弱于当年的慕洪！
又是一位人杰啊！
赵天河在心中感叹，这个年轻人成长起来后，只怕不比慕洪弱。
可惜，他又怎么知道叶欢的实力已经可以媲美现在的慕洪了。
真正实战起来，即便是如今的慕洪，也绝不是叶欢的对手。
赵天河现在完全相信叶欢，堂堂一个年轻武者，怎么可能骗他十万块钱。
赵月夕心头也震惊了，他不了解武者的实力，但是叶欢这一手真的吓到她了。
一拳击穿柳树，何等恐怖的力量。
她撇了撇嘴，这个家伙怎么这么暴力啊，自己不过是随便说了一句，他就发这么大的脾气。
可是看到叶欢这么强，她心里也很高兴，说明他是真的有本事。
这样，她爷爷的病就有救了！
“月夕小孩子不懂事，说错话了，还望叶先生见谅。”赵天河连忙道歉。
以他赵家的实力，虽然不惧一个普通的战士级武者，但这样得罪一个可能怀有神奇医术的天才人杰，实属不智。
叶欢点点头，也不去计较，他不喜欢斤斤计较，不过，在地球上，还没有人能够威胁他。
“不知道叶先生现在住在哪里？”赵天河忽然问道。
“我刚来林城，还没有住处，就在学校旁边找了一个旅馆暂住。”
赵天河微微一笑，道：“以叶先生的身份，怎么能住在这种地方呢，我这里有一套复合式公寓，如果叶先生不嫌弃，就送给叶先生了。”
虽然只是公寓，不是别墅，不过确实精致的豪华套房，按照林城的房价，至少价值上百万。
而叶欢要求的定金，也不过十万，赵天河一出手便是大手笔。
“好。”叶欢也没有客气，住在宾馆的确不是长久之计，能够有套房子自然是极好的。
一套数百万的房子在叶欢心中不算什么，他自然也不会感到受宠若惊。
“那好，叶先生还要去准备什么东西吗？收拾好了我就让司机送你去。”赵天河客气地说道。
他一方枭雄，能够如此尊敬叶欢，不仅是因为他是一位年轻的武者，同样是一位神医，唯一可以挽留自己生命的神医。
这些种种身份加成，即便是赵家的老爷子，也不得对叶欢十分尊敬。
“不用了，我自己去就行了，你把钥匙和地址给我就行了。”叶欢直接说道。
赵天河打了个电话，很快便有人送来了钥匙，然后又把地址告诉了叶欢。
叶欢点点头，直接转身告辞。
看着叶欢离开的背影，赵月夕笑着道：“爷爷你太狡猾了，你送他房子，就可以方便监视他了，这样，就不怕他跑了。”
“说不定他还以为占了大便宜，还在心中感谢你呢，你这是一石二鸟。”
赵天河摇摇头，道：“月夕，你猜错了，我送给他房子，只是纯粹的示好，没有监视他的意思。”
content_en:
Chapter 28 Summer
Zhao Tianhe's pupils suddenly shrank, this man's power was so terrifying.
If it were an ordinary person, even if they had enough strength, they could only break the willow tree. Direct penetration like this would require precise power control.
This man is definitely a warrior! And his strength is not weaker than Mu Hong back then!
Another outstanding person!
Zhao Tianhe sighed in his heart that when this young man grows up, he will probably not be weaker than Mu Hong.
It's a pity, how did he know that Ye Huan's strength was comparable to Mu Hong now.
In actual combat, even Mu Hong today is no match for Ye Huan.
Zhao Tianhe now completely believed Ye Huan. How could a dignified young martial artist cheat him out of one hundred thousand yuan?
Zhao Yuexi was also shocked. He didn't understand the warrior's strength, but Ye Huan's move really scared her.
One punch punched through the willow tree, what a terrifying power.
She curled her lips, why is this guy so violent? He just said something casually and he got so angry.
But she was very happy to see Ye Huan so strong, which showed that he was really capable.
In this way, her grandfather's illness will be cured!
"Yuexi is a child who is not sensible and said something wrong. I hope Mr. Ye can forgive me." Zhao Tianhe apologized quickly.
With the strength of his Zhao family, although he is not afraid of an ordinary warrior-level warrior, it is unwise to offend a talented person who may have miraculous medical skills.
Ye Huan nodded and didn't care. He didn't like to argue, but no one on earth could threaten him.
"I wonder where Mr. Ye lives now?" Zhao Tianhe suddenly asked.
"I just came to Lincheng and I didn't have a place to live yet, so I found a hotel next to the school to stay temporarily."
Zhao Tianhe smiled slightly and said: "With Mr. Ye's status, how can I live in a place like this? I have a complex apartment here. If Mr. Ye doesn't dislike it, I will give it to Mr. Ye."
Although it is only an apartment, not a villa, it is indeed an exquisite luxury suite. According to Lincheng's housing prices, it is worth at least millions.
The deposit required by Ye Huan was only 100,000, so Zhao Tianhe was very generous when he made the move.
"Okay." Ye Huan was not polite. Living in a hotel was indeed not a long-term solution. It would be great to have a house.
A multi-million house is nothing in Ye Huan's heart, so he naturally won't feel flattered.
"Okay, Mr. Ye, do you need to prepare anything else? Once you've packed it up, I'll ask the driver to take you there." Zhao Tianhe said politely.
He was a powerful man and could respect Ye Huan so much not only because he was a young warrior, but also a miracle doctor, the only one who could save his life.
With these various status bonuses, even the old man of the Zhao family cannot respect Ye Huan very much.
"No, I can just go by myself. Just give me the key and address." Ye Huan said directly.
Zhao Tianhe made a call, and someone soon sent the keys, and then told Ye Huan the address.
Ye Huan nodded and turned around to leave.
Looking at Ye Huan's leaving figure, Zhao Yuexi smiled and said: "Grandpa, you are so cunning. If you give him a house, you can monitor him more easily. This way, you won't be afraid of him running away."
"Maybe he thought he got a big advantage and was still thanking you in his heart. You killed two birds with one stone."
Zhao Tianhe shook his head and said, "Yue Xi, you guessed wrong. I gave him the house as a pure show of goodwill and had no intention of monitoring him."
